thread:
mia_devex: Heads up — planning a small hotpatch publish for py/ts SDKs this Friday 10:00 PDT. Need pin list, changelog draft, and rollback gating.

alex_release: can we move to 10:00 instead of 09:00? CI had flaky artifacts at 08:30 this morning.

mia_devex: 10:00 works for me. Window 10:00–11:00 PDT. Will coordinate with deploy-bot + docs.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: py/ts-sdk v1.18.3 -> v1.18.4 (hotfix). Canary at 10:00 PDT. Rollout plan: 5% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m checkpoints.

sam_engineer: Hotfix includes packaging checksum validation and a TLS header parsing fix. Pin strategy: publish 1.18.4; add yarn/npm pin snippets and internal yarn resolutions for critical customers.

emily_docs: Drafting release notes now. Will list: checksum validation fix, TLS header fix, and deprecation note for legacy sync client. Ping me any wording changes.

jordan_pm: We need a short deprecation line: "legacy sync client removed 2026-06-01" — product/legal want a link to migration guide.

alex_release: Rollback criteria (agreed): 5xx rate > 0.3% sustained for 5m OR P95 token latency up >200ms vs baseline for 5m. If triggered -> immediate rollback to v1.18.3 + incident.

sam_engineer: Local smoke commands: `python -m pip install redwood-sdk==1.18.4rc1 --no-cache-dir` then `pytest tests/smoke/publish_smoke.py -k tls` — run before canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 10:00:01 PDT — 5% traffic to v1.18.4 canary. Logs: https://deploys.example.com/1802001234/canary

mia_devex: Watching metrics. @alex_release please confirm alerts are armed.

alex_release: Alerts armed: sdk-5xx, sdk-p95-latency, release-rollback. PD on-call: @sam_engineer.

sam_engineer: Canary looks clean at 8m. 5xx=0.02%, no P95 regression. Proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: Rollout 50% at 10:08:12 PDT. Next checkpoint scheduled at 10:18 for 100%.

sam_engineer: 50% stable. Tagging release notes draft: https://docs.example.com/releases/1.18.4 (draft). emily_docs, please take final pass.

emily_docs: Final pass done. Added migration snippet for TS: `// old
import { Client } from '@redwood/sdk'
// new
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })` and deprecation blurb.

jordan_pm: Please include a short customer email blurb about the deprecation timeline + link to migration doc. I'll take it to comms.

deploy-bot: Rollout 100% at 10:19:59 PDT. Release complete. Artifacts published to PyPI and npm. Checksums verified.

mia_devex: Thanks all — great coordination. I'll post a short recap in #all-hands tomorrow and follow up on customer comms + deprecation schedule.

(quick notes: remember to add `yarn resolutions` snippet to internal onboarding, update SDK changelog with migration steps, and schedule a cleanup ticket to remove legacy sync client stubs after deprecation date.)
